name: Performance Engineering Principles
description: Performance Engineering Principles standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-PERF applies.

rules.title: Define budgets for latency, throughput and resource use
rules.detail: Critical flows establish measurable performance budgets appropriate to client, API, database and infrastructure layers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define budgets for latency, throughput and resource use.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define budgets for latency, throughput and resource use.

rules.title: Measure before and after optimization
rules.detail: Use profiling, tracing and production-like measurements to identify bottlenecks and confirm impact; avoid intuition-only optimization.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Measure before and after optimization.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Measure before and after optimization.

rules.title: Protect against unbounded work
rules.detail: Collections, payloads, queries, retries, logs and background work must have explicit bounds, pagination, batching or rate limits.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect against unbounded work.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect against unbounded work.

rules.title: Prefer efficient data access patterns
rules.detail: Avoid N+1 queries, unnecessary full scans, repeated network round trips and over-fetching on critical paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prefer efficient data access patterns.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prefer efficient data access patterns.

rules.title: Treat memory and connection pools as finite resources
rules.detail: Define limits and lifecycle for caches, threads/tasks, sockets, database connections and large buffers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat memory and connection pools as finite resources.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat memory and connection pools as finite resources.

rules.title: Detect regressions in delivery pipelines or observability
rules.detail: High-risk or critical paths should have repeatable performance checks and production telemetry against budgets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Detect regressions in delivery pipelines or observability.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Detect regressions in delivery pipelines or observability.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-PERF applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Performance Engineering Principles to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Performance Engineering Principles is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Performance Engineering Principles failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
